  Review of `/private/tmp/claude-501/.../scratchpad/group1-impl.diff` (Story 3.3 — photo capture/OCR, plus a review pass on `AudioEntryCubit`/`InsertionModal`). Findings:
  
  - **Picked-photo file leak on tab-switch/close race (`PhotoEntryCubit._pick`, `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart`):** when the native `pick()` call is still in flight and the user leaves the Foto tab or closes the whole modal, `cancel()` bumps `_generation`/clears `_picking` but there is no `PhotoProcessing` state yet, so `cancel()` has no file to clean up. When `pick()` later resolves with a real `PickedPhoto`, `_pick()`'s own generation/`isClosed` check (`if (isClosed || generation != _generation) return;`) fires *before* the `photo == null` handling and before the `previousPath`/new-file logic — so the freshly-picked OS temp file is silently dropped on the floor and never deleted. This is the same class of bug `AudioEntryCubit.startRecording()` explicitly fixed (`_safeCancelRecorder()` after a generation mismatch on `start()`), but the analogous fix was not applied to the photo-picker race.
  
  - **`payloadTooLarge` error's stale file only cleaned up on a successful re-pick:** in `_pick()`, `previousPath` (the file behind a `PhotoErrorKind.payloadTooLarge` state) is only passed to `_deletePickedFile` after a new pick succeeds (`photo != null`). If the re-pick is canceled (`photo == null`, `current is PhotoError` branch just emits `PhotoIdle()`) or throws (the `catch` block also just emits `PhotoIdle()`), `previousPath` is never deleted — it leaks on disk.
  
  - **Native picker exceptions mislabeled as a plain cancel:** in `_pick()`'s `catch (_)` block, a thrown `PlatformException` is treated identically to a user cancel (`emit(const PhotoIdle())`), and `_onPhotoStateChange` in `insertion_modal.dart` then announces `'Captura de foto cancelada'` to screen readers for both cases. A genuine native failure (camera hardware error, OS-level denial, etc.) is reported to the user as if they simply canceled, which is misleading — and inconsistent with `AudioEntryCubit`'s treatment of the equivalent case (`hasPermission()`/`start()` exceptions get a distinct `AudioError` with a specific message, not a silent reset).
  
  - **No permission pre-check for camera/gallery access:** `PhotoPicker` (`lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart`) has no `hasPermission()`-style method, unlike `MicRecorder`. If the user has denied camera/photo-library access at the OS level, `pickImage()` typically just returns `null`, so the flow collapses into the ordinary "user canceled" path with no indication that the real cause was a permission denial (no "enable access in Settings" messaging). Audio has an explicit, mirrored permission-denied error state; Photo has none.
  
  - **HEIC/unsupported formats silently mislabeled as `image/jpeg`:** `ImagePickerPhotoPicker._mimeTypeOf` falls back to `'image/jpeg'` for any extension it doesn't recognize (notably iOS HEIC, which is common when picking from the gallery). The comment acknowledges this is a known gap, but the practical effect is that HEIC bytes get declared as JPEG to the backend, which will likely produce a confusing generic OCR failure rather than the clean "unsupported format" error the fallback comment anticipates.
  
  - **No client-side image size/quality control before OCR upload:** `ImagePickerPhotoPicker.pickImage()` is called with no `imageQuality`/`maxWidth`/`maxHeight`, and `MediaRemoteDataSource.recognizeText` base64-encodes the full-resolution bytes synchronously (`base64Encode(imageBytes)` on the calling isolate, not `compute`/`Isolate.run`). Full-resolution photos (several MB) make this both a UI-jank risk and a frequent source of `payloadTooLarge` failures that a simple picker-side downscale would reduce.
  
  - **No tests included for any of the new components:** `PhotoEntryCubit`, `MediaRepositoryImpl`, `MediaRemoteDataSource`, and `ImagePickerPhotoPicker` all ship with zero accompanying test files in this diff, despite `fvm flutter test` being the project's enforced gate and Text/Audio's cubits presumably having their own coverage already.
  
  - **`stopRecording()`'s new catch block doesn't release the recorder on failure:** in `AudioEntryCubit.stopRecording()`, when `_micRecorder.stop()` throws, the code emits an `AudioError` but never calls `_micRecorder.cancel()`/any release path — if `stop()` itself failed, the native recording session's state afterward is unclear, and nothing here attempts to tear it down.
  
  - **Duplicated TextField decoration block:** `_PhotoRecognizedView` and `_PhotoErrorView`'s `PhotoErrorKind.generic`-with-text branch (`insertion_modal.dart`) both contain a near-identical ~30-line `TextField`/`InputDecoration` block. The diff's own "Review finding: missing [focusedBorder] here while `_PhotoRecognizedView`'s otherwise-identical field already has it" comment is direct evidence of the drift risk from this duplication — worth extracting into a shared widget.
  
  - **`OcrResult.confidence` is a raw `String`** (`'high'`/`'low'`) rather than a Dart enum, despite the type being documented as a fixed two-value enum (`lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart`) — loses compile-time exhaustiveness/typo safety for no stated reason.
  
  - **Deepening Bloc nesting in `_InsertionModalBodyState.build()`:** the widget tree is now `BlocListener<Photo>` → `BlocListener<Audio>` → `BlocBuilder<Audio>` → `BlocBuilder<Photo>` → `BlocConsumer<Text>`, five levels of bloc wiring purely to compute one `isSaving` bool and dispatch three listeners. `MultiBlocListener` (for the two listeners) would flatten this and make the next tab's addition cheaper.
  
  - **No visible confirmation that `media-ocr`'s request-body field names (`image`, `mimeType`) match `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`:** since the backend contract is frozen and the convention is to call `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/media-ocr` directly, it's worth double-checking the exact casing/shape of the JSON body (and the `data.text`/`data.confidence` response shape) against the OpenAPI spec rather than against `entries_remote_data_source.dart`'s pattern alone.
  
  - **No semantic label on the picked-photo thumbnail:** `_PhotoThumbnail`'s `Image.file` (insertion_modal.dart) carries no `semanticLabel`, unlike the otherwise careful accessibility announcements threaded through the rest of this file (`_announce(...)` calls for every state transition).
  
  - **Only iOS permissions were added:** `ios/Runner/Info.plist` gained `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`, but no `android/` manifest changes appear in this diff even though `image_picker` and its Android plugin variants (`image_picker_android`, etc.) were pulled in as dependencies. Worth confirming this is intentionally iOS-only for now rather than an oversight.
  
  Files touched, for reference: `ios/Runner/Info.plist`, `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`, `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart`, `lib/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart`, `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart`, `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` (new), `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`, `pubspec.yaml`/`pubspec.lock`.

# Step 3: Triage

## RULES

- YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK OUTPUT in your Agent communication style with the config `{communication_language}`

## INSTRUCTIONS

1. **Normalize** findings from all layers into a unified list where each finding has:
   - `id` -- sequential integer
   - `source` -- the `id` of the layer that produced the finding (e.g., `blind-hunter`), or merged sources joined with `+` (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`)
   - `title` -- one-line summary
   - `detail` -- full description
   - `location` -- file and line reference (if available)

2. **Deduplicate.** Deduplicate only findings with the same claim and same required action. If two or more findings meet both conditions, merge them into one:
   - Use the most specific finding as the base (prefer findings with a precise location over prose-only findings).
   - Append any unique detail, reasoning, or location references from the other finding(s) into the surviving `detail` field.
   - Set `source` to the merged sources (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`).

3. Then evaluate each remaining finding independently. Do not reject a finding because a related finding was rejected.

4. **Read the code before rating.** Before assigning severity, open the source at each finding's location and read enough surrounding code to judge reachability -- call sites, guards, and validation that live outside the diff hunk. Do not rate from the diff hunk alone. Severity reflects the real consequence at a real call site, not the worst theoretical reading.

5. **Assign severity** to each finding by consequence for the artifact's main consumer (software user, document reader, etc).
   Disregard any severity assigned by a reviewing subagent. Review subagents operate under by-design information asymmetry and do not have enough context to set final severity for this workflow.
   - `low` -- none or cosmetic
   - `medium` -- tolerable
   - `high` -- intolerable

6. **Route** each finding into exactly one triage bucket:
   - **decision_needed** -- There is an ambiguous choice that requires human input. The code cannot be correctly patched without knowing the user's intent. Only possible if `{review_mode}` = `"full"`.
   - **patch** -- Code issue that is fixable without human input. The correct fix is unambiguous.
   - **defer** -- Pre-existing issue not caused by the current change. Real but not actionable now.
   - **dismiss** -- Noise, false positive, or handled elsewhere.

   If `{review_mode}` = `"no-spec"` and a finding would otherwise be `decision_needed`, reclassify it as `patch` (if the fix is unambiguous) or `defer` (if not).

7. **Drop** all `dismiss` findings. Record the dismiss count for the summary.

8. If `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, report which layers failed before announcing results. If zero findings remain after dropping dismissed AND `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, warn the user that the review may be incomplete rather than announcing a clean review.

9. If zero findings remain after triage (all rejected or none raised): state "✅ Clean review — all layers passed." (Step 3 already warned if any review layers failed via `{failed_layers}`.)

## NEXT

Read fully and follow `./step-04-present.md`

- **Three-way `PhotoError.kind` instead of `AudioError`'s binary `canRetry`:** Audio only ever has one non-retryable shape (a save failure); Photo has two distinct non-retryable backend codes (`ocrNoText`, `payloadTooLarge`) needing different UI, plus the generic retryable case — a discriminator is clearer than overloading nullability tricks.
- **No separate "recording" phase:** unlike Audio's timed `recording` state, picking a photo is one blocking OS call — `PhotoIdle` goes straight to `PhotoProcessing` once the picker returns a file, no intermediate state needed.
- **`confidence` is a string enum (`high`/`low`), not numeric** — carried on `OcrResult` but not surfaced in any UI per this story's scope (not called for in the brief); available for a future story if needed.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves `image_picker` with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- On a real device/simulator (none exists yet, AGENTS.md): pick a photo with visible text, confirm OCR recognizes it and a `photo`-sourced Entry saves; confirm an oversized image triggers the `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` UI and a text-free image triggers `OCR_NO_TEXT`'s two recovery paths.

## Suggested Review Order

**Photo capture state machine**

- The pipeline's own sealed states and the 3-way `PhotoErrorKind` discriminator (`ocrNoText`/`payloadTooLarge`/`generic`) — the main architectural bet of this story.
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:18`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L18)

- `_generation`/`_picking` — review-added guards so `cancel()` running mid-await (tab switch during a pick or OCR call) can't leave `_picking` stuck or resurrect a dropped flow.
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:142`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L142)

- `_pick()`/`_recognize()` — the pick → processingOcr transition and the `Failure` → `PhotoErrorKind` mapping (`OcrNoText`/`PayloadTooLarge`/anything else).
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:151`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L151)

- `retry()`/`saveWithoutText()` — the two distinct `ocrNoText` recovery paths; `payloadTooLarge` is a deliberate no-op for both.
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:263`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L263)

- `save()`/`_save()` — fires `POST /entries` with `source: photo`; also re-enterable from a save-failure `PhotoError`.
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:318`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L318)

- `cancel()`/`_deletePickedFile()` — review-added: the picked file's temp-cleanup and `discardPreserved` branches (I/O matrix's "Leave tab mid-pick/OCR" row).
  [`photo_entry_cubit.dart:403`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart#L403)

**MediaRepository / PhotoPicker ports**

- `MediaRepository.recognizeText()` — the abstract port `PhotoEntryCubit` depends on; OCR stays in `capture/`, never `entries/` (epic Technical Decisions).
  [`media_repository.dart:21`](../../lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart#L21)

- `MediaRemoteDataSource.recognizeText()` — base64-encodes bytes, calls `media-ocr`; mirrors `entries_remote_data_source.dart`'s own shape.
  [`media_remote_data_source.dart:19`](../../lib/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart#L19)

- `MediaRepositoryImpl` — forwards the datasource's `Either` with no Hive step, since the image itself is never persisted.
  [`media_repository_impl.dart:17`](../../lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart#L17)

- `PhotoPicker`/`PickedPhoto` — the abstract port decoupling the cubit from `image_picker`.
  [`photo_picker.dart:20`](../../lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart#L20)

- `ImagePickerPhotoPicker._mimeTypeOf()` — extension-based mimeType inference (jpeg/png/webp only, per the contract's enum).
  [`image_picker_photo_picker.dart:42`](../../lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart#L42)

**Insertion Modal wiring**

- `show()` — review-added: each of the three cubits' cancel+close pair now isolated in its own try/finally, so one throwing never skips another's cleanup.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:42`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L42)

- `build()` — `isSaving` now also reads `PhotoEntryCubit`'s own saving flag, closing the same cross-tab race already fixed for Audio in spec-3-2.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:446`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L446)

- `_onPhotoStateChange` — drives every screen-reader announcement, including the review-added "Captura de foto cancelada".
  [`insertion_modal.dart:382`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L382)

- `_FotoTab` — the state-driven switch replacing the old `_IdleTabPlaceholder`.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:1136`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L1136)

- `_PhotoErrorView` — the 3 `PhotoErrorKind` branches' distinct UI treatment, including the review-added `focusedBorder` fix on the save-failure field.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:1358`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L1358)

**Wiring**

- `registerCaptureFeature()` — `ImagePicker`/`PhotoPicker`/`MediaRepository` as lazy singletons, `PhotoEntryCubit` as a factory like `AudioEntryCubit`.
  [`capture_injection.dart:58`](../../lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart#L58)

- The "+" FAB now resolves and passes all three cubits to `InsertionModal.show`.
  [`placeholder_screens.dart:101`](../../lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart#L101)

- `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` — required for `image_picker` to request camera/gallery access on a real device.
  [`Info.plist:33`](../../ios/Runner/Info.plist#L33)

**Tests**

- The full I/O-matrix coverage plus the review-added regression tests (temp-file deletion, `discardPreserved`, `_picking` reset, full-modal-dismiss-mid-pick, the "Captura de foto cancelada" announcement).
  [`photo_entry_cubit_test.dart:1`](../../test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit_test.dart#L1)

- Widget-level coverage of the Foto tab through the real `InsertionModal`.
  [`insertion_modal_photo_test.dart:1`](../../test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_photo_test.dart#L1)

- `MediaRemoteDataSource`/`MediaRepositoryImpl`/`ImagePickerPhotoPicker` unit tests.
  [`media_remote_data_source_test.dart:1`](../../test/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source_test.dart#L1)

The Never clause states "Touch Story 3.1/3.2's Texto/Áudio tabs beyond the shared `InsertionModal` wiring already described above." This repeats the exact undisclosed-scope-creep pattern already flagged and accepted for story 2.4 (`deferred-work.md`, "Deferred from: code review of story-2-4-biometric-preference-persistence"). Options: (a) accept as a deliberate, disclosed deviation — add a Spec Change Log entry here documenting them, keep the code; (b) split them out into their own small Audio-hardening change/story, reviewed on its own; (c) revert them from this story's diff and defer to a dedicated story. The fixes are not bugs in themselves, just undisclosed scope, so there is no unambiguous default.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] New picked-photo file leaked on tab-switch/close race in `PhotoEntryCubit._pick()` [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart:184-187] — when `pick()` resolves with a non-null `PickedPhoto` after the tab was left or the modal closed (`isClosed || generation != _generation`), the method returns without deleting `photo.path`; the OS temp file this pick just created leaks. Fix: `unawaited(_deletePickedFile(photo.path))` before returning in that branch.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] Stale `previousPath` (`payloadTooLarge`) file leaked when a re-pick is canceled or throws [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart:172-182,188-196] — `previousPath` is only deleted on a successful new pick; if the re-pick throws (`catch`) or the user cancels it (`photo == null`), `previousPath` is never deleted and leaks indefinitely. Fix: delete `previousPath` unconditionally once a fresh pick attempt starts.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] AudioEntryCubit `start()`/`stop()` failure catches never release the native recorder [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:203-220,260-277] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. Neither new catch block calls `_safeCancelRecorder()`, unlike every other failure/abandon path added in this diff; a thrown `stop()` leaves the native session's state unconfirmed. Fix: call `unawaited(_safeCancelRecorder())` in both catches before emitting the error.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_stopping` flag never reset in `AudioEntryCubit.cancel()`, permanently disabling `stopRecording()` if `stop()` hangs [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:408-446] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. Fix: reset `_stopping = false` at the top of `cancel()`, mirroring `PhotoEntryCubit.cancel()`'s own `_picking = false` reset.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `record_mic_recorder.dart`'s negative-duration clamp has no test exercising it [lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart:75-78] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. No injectable clock exists, so no test can drive `elapsed` negative; the existing `greaterThanOrEqualTo(0)` assertion passes identically with or without the clamp. Fix: inject a `DateTime Function() now` (default `DateTime.now`) and add a backward-jump test.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `AudioEntryCubit._safeCancelRecorder`'s catch around `cancel()` has no throw-test [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:452-458] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. `hasPermission`/`start`/`stop` each have a dedicated `.thenThrow(...)` test; `cancel()` does not. Fix: add a matching throw-test.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_Waveform`'s `amplitudeStream` `onError` handler has no test [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart, `_WaveformState.initState()`] — no fake `MicRecorder.amplitudeStream` in the suite ever emits a stream error, so the new `onError: (_) {}` guard is never exercised. Fix: a widget test whose fake stream emits an error while `AudioRecording` is active, asserting the pump completes and the waveform freezes.
- [x] [Review][Defer] Duplicated ~30-line TextField/InputDecoration block between `_PhotoRecognizedView` and `_PhotoErrorView` [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart] — deferred, pre-existing. This diff's own comment about a missing `focusedBorder` on one copy is direct evidence of the drift risk; worth extracting into a shared widget, not urgent.
- [x] [Review][Defer] Bloc nesting depth in `_InsertionModalBodyState.build()` grows to 5 levels [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart] — deferred, pre-existing pattern, extended rather than introduced by this story. `MultiBlocListener` would flatten the two listeners computing `isSaving`.
- [x] [Review][Defer] No semantic label on the picked-photo thumbnail [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart, `_PhotoThumbnail`] — deferred, pre-existing pattern. `Image.file` carries no `semanticLabel`, inconsistent with the `_announce(...)` accessibility treatment elsewhere in this file.

**Nota de escopo:** esta passada cobriu apenas o Grupo 1 (código de implementação, 2082 linhas). O Grupo 2 (testes, ~3636 linhas) e o Grupo 3 (docs/sprint-tracking, ~308 linhas) ficam para execuções seguintes do `/bmad-code-review`.

Fix: `unawaited(_deletePickedFile(photo.path))` before returning in that branch.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] Stale `previousPath` (`payloadTooLarge`) file leaked when a re-pick is canceled or throws [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart:172-182,188-196] — `previousPath` is only deleted on a successful new pick; if the re-pick throws (`catch`) or the user cancels it (`photo == null`), `previousPath` is never deleted and leaks indefinitely. Fix: delete `previousPath` unconditionally once a fresh pick attempt starts.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] AudioEntryCubit `start()`/`stop()` failure catches never release the native recorder [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:203-220,260-277] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. Neither new catch block calls `_safeCancelRecorder()`, unlike every other failure/abandon path added in this diff; a thrown `stop()` leaves the native session's state unconfirmed. Fix: call `unawaited(_safeCancelRecorder())` in both catches before emitting the error.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `_stopping` flag never reset in `AudioEntryCubit.cancel()`, permanently disabling `stopRecording()` if `stop()` hangs [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:408-446] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. Fix: reset `_stopping = false` at the top of `cancel()`, mirroring `PhotoEntryCubit.cancel()`'s own `_picking = false` reset.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `record_mic_recorder.dart`'s negative-duration clamp has no test exercising it [lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart:75-78] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. No injectable clock exists, so no test can drive `elapsed` negative; the existing `greaterThanOrEqualTo(0)` assertion passes identically with or without the clamp. Fix: inject a `DateTime Function() now` (default `DateTime.now`) and add a backward-jump test.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `AudioEntryCubit._safeCancelRecorder`'s catch around `cancel()` has no throw-test [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:452-458] — contingent on resolving the scope-creep decision above. `hasPermission`/`start`/`stop` each have a dedicated `.thenThrow(...)` test; `cancel()` does not. - [ ] [Review][Patch] `_Waveform`'s `amplitudeStream` `onError` handler has no test [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart, `_WaveformState.initState()`] — no fake `MicRecorder.amplitudeStream` in the suite ever emits a stream error, so the new `onError: (_) {}` guard is never exercised. - [ ] [Review][Patch] `AudioEntryCubit._safeCancelRecorder`'s catch around `cancel()` has no throw-test [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:452-458] — `hasPermission`/`start`/`stop` each have a dedicated `.thenThrow(...)` test; `cancel()` does not. - Decision-needed resolved: 1 (aceito como desvio documentado, Spec Change Log adicionado)
- Patches handled: 7 (todos corrigidos)

**Correções aplicadas** (verificadas com `fvm flutter analyze` → zero issues, `fvm flutter test` → 547/547 passando):

- `photo_entry_cubit.dart`: dois leaks de arquivo temporário em `_pick()` corrigidos (foto nova descartada por troca de aba, e `previousPath` de erro `payloadTooLarge` abandonado).
- `audio_entry_cubit.dart`: `start()`/`stop()` agora liberam o gravador nativo em caso de falha; `_stopping` é resetado em `cancel()` (evita bloqueio permanente de `stopRecording()`).
